checkpointProtocol.independence: No checkpoint used for control fitting, ICP, scale estimation, camera calibration, correction or threshold tuning
checkpointProtocol.selection: Declare representative spatial strata before evaluation: footprint quadrants, height bands, separated components and feature classes; include weak/occluded-adjacent regions
checkpointProtocol.holdoutRule: Proposed: at least 20% of independently surveyed usable landmarks and at least 30 checkpoint observations per claimed profile/assessment unit; meeting the count alone is insufficient
checkpointProtocol.smallFeatureAlternative: Independent high-accuracy patch reference or calibrated artefact with documented uncertainty and equivalent spatial coverage; justify the protocol explicitly
checkpointProtocol.residual: e_i = norm(modelPosition_i - independentReferencePosition_i) after the frozen registered transform
checkpointProtocol.rmse: sqrt(sum(e_i^2)/N); report additionally, never substitute for maximum or coverage
checkpointProtocol.p95: Sort all retained e_i ascending; use nearest-rank e_(ceil(0.95*N)); N must be stated
checkpointProtocol.maximum: Maximum retained 3D residual; do not delete large residuals merely to pass
checkpointProtocol.outliers: Preserve raw observations and full-set statistics; any exclusion must have an independent documented cause, affected region and both before/after results
checkpointProtocol.distribution: Report statistics by spatial stratum and feature class; a good global score does not qualify an untested region
checkpointProtocol.notProofOf: All-surface accuracy, hidden fabric, interiors, manufacturing suitability or a formal survey certification

components: sensor calibration and image/laser measurement uncertainty
errorBudget.combinationRule: Document bias and dependence. Use root-sum-square only with justified independence/distribution assumptions; otherwise use a conservative bound or mark unquantified. Report independent end-to-end checkpoint results regardless.
errorBudget.planningAllocation: Recommended control/reference uncertainty <= one third of selected P95 target; proposed allocation, not a guarantee
errorBudget.unknownValuePolicy: null/unknown is not zero and cannot pass a numeric acceptance gate
